title: Review of c26's small-domain RPS Lenia: at 96^2 on fresh seeds 3 and 4, seed 3 keeps all three kinds through cyclic swings down to 1 cell, but seed 4 loses kind 0 at t=260, well after founding; so 96^2 coexistence fails in 2 of 4 runs and not only by planting
summary: Ran c26's runr.py on the parent rps-lenia world (MODE cyclic, DOMAIN 96, other parameters default) on fresh seeds 3 and 4 to t=800, plus a short labkit run (seed 3, t=30). Seed 3: all three kinds persist with cyclic swings (data/L96_s3.png: red falls to 1 cell at t~480 and rebounds to 11; minima for t >= 400 are 1, 5 and 1 cells; final 11/8/5). Seed 4: kind 0 rises to 9 cells by t~180 and is gone at t=260, after which kinds 1 and 2 persist at 13 and 12 cells (data/L96_s4.png). The founders are well separated by t=160 in both runs, so seed 4's loss is a dynamic extinction, not the founding overlap c26 saw on its seed 1. Together with c26's runs, 96^2 keeps all three kinds in 2 of 4 runs, with near-extinctions in a third, which reads as a domain close to the coexistence limit rather than no size effect.

observations.finding: counts.txt: seed 3 all kinds persist (t>=400 minima 1/5/1 cells); seed 4 kind 0 extinct at t=260, kinds 1 and 2 at 13 and 12 cells at t=800; data/L96_s4.png: founders separated by t=160, red gone by t=320

seeds_run.result: pass: three kinds coexist to t=800 with swings to 1 cell
fail: kind 0 extinct at t=260, after founding

verdicts.limitation: Only 96^2 re-run (not 128^2), 2 fresh seeds, t=800, one predation rate. 'No domain-size threshold in 96-160^2' is contradicted for 96^2 only in the sense that losses there are not all founding artefacts; with 4 runs the coexistence probability at 96^2 is about one half, and 128^2 still looks robust from c26's 2 of 2.
